sections.Profile:
Mibs , produced by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1969, is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine with a marbles theme. Designed by Ed Krynski and featuring artwork by Art Stenholm, Mibs includes two flippers, four pop bumpers, and a unique mechanical backbox animation that adds marbles as players progress.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1969
- In production: no
